# fixtures

Sample files for the `pdf/` → `tei/` → `md/` conversion pipeline, used by the
unit tests in `grobid-core` and the end-to-end script
`crates/grobid-cli/tests/e2e.sh`.

## Directory Structure

```
fixtures/
├── pdf/         # Input PDF files (8 papers)
├── tei/         # TEI XML output (GROBID-generated)
├── md/          # Markdown output with frontmatter
├── .grobid/     # All generated corpus artifacts:
│   ├── index.html      # Corpus dashboard (committed — open in a browser)
│   ├── process.json    # Run manifest (committed example)
│   ├── metadata/       # Per-work metadata JSON (generated, gitignored)
│   ├── grobid.db       # Corpus SQLite DB (generated, gitignored)
│   └── index.json      # JSON search index (generated, gitignored)
└── README.md
```

## Example Files

- **pdf/**, **tei/**, **md/** — 8 stroke/neuroimaging papers covering the
  full pipeline.
- **.grobid/index.html** — self-contained corpus dashboard for this data:
  force-directed citation graph plus a stats sidebar (counts, year
  distribution chart, most-cited/most-citing/top-author rankings) with one
  unified search filter. Open it directly in a browser — d3 is loaded from
  CDN, so it needs network access once. Generated by `grobid graph`.
- **.grobid/process.json** — manifest of conversion runs (counts, per-file
  status, timing, GROBID URL); appended on every `grobid` run, capped at
  the last 50 runs.

## Regenerating .grobid/index.html

The committed `index.html` is generated from the corpus DB. To rebuild it
after changing the fixtures or the renderer:

```bash
cargo build -p grobid-cli
GROBID_DATA_DIR=crates/grobid-core/tests/fixtures ./target/debug/grobid
GROBID_DATA_DIR=crates/grobid-core/tests/fixtures ./target/debug/grobid graph
# outputs land in fixtures/.grobid/
```

The first command re-indexes the corpus into `fixtures/.grobid/grobid.db`
(TEI and Markdown are already cached, so no GROBID server is needed); the
second writes `fixtures/.grobid/index.html`.

## Running the Example

```bash
./crates/grobid-cli/tests/e2e.sh   # from the repository root
```

The e2e script copies the fixture PDFs into a throwaway data dir and runs
the full pipeline (PDF → GROBID → TEI → Markdown → corpus →
search/stats/graph → cached re-run), so it exercises real GROBID
conversion rather than the cached outputs here.

## Requirements

- Docker (for running the GROBID server)
- Rust toolchain (to build the binary)
